cards.title: Buttonwood Library Train Draft Checklist Card
cards.draftChecklistSkill: check one fictional library-train draft for a clear helper, useful place details, ordered moments, sentence clarity, and one next-draft pencil note
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable composition notebook draft checklist card for checking one invented library-train story draft on paper only: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place a composition notebook page beside the card and choose one pretend Buttonwood Library Train draft to check: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: read the draft once, then use pencil marks to show what the library-train story already has and what needs a note: ____________________.
cards.characterCheckPrompt: Character check: write the made-up helper's name and the one library-train job the helper is trying to finish: ____________________.
cards.settingCheckPrompt: Setting check: list two invented train details, such as a button shelf, question card, or ticket tag, that the draft uses: ____________________.
cards.sequenceCheckPrompt: Sequence check: write the first train clue, the next shelf choice, and the final finished moment in order: ____________________.
cards.detailCheckPrompt: Detail check: circle one detail that helps the errand make sense and mark one extra detail that can wait for another story: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCheckPrompt: Sentence check: choose one sentence and make sure the reader can tell who is doing the action: ____________________.
cards.finalDraftChecklistPrompt: Final draft checklist: write one pencil note for the next draft about the character, setting, sequence, detail, or sentence to improve: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to one checklist row, and the writer fills only that row before taking a short paper pause: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: check another pretend library-train draft for a helper, place details, ordered moments, useful details, clear sentences, and one pencil note: ____________________.
